Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREIn this bundleRudolph The Red Nosed Reindeer$29.99+Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer - King Moonracer’s Kingdom of MisfitsView add-onDescriptionJoin in All the Reindeer Games - And Save Christmas! Dash into the enchanting world of Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer and embark on a quest to save Christmas in this magical adventure inspired by the animated classic! Journey through Rudolph’s winter wonderlands as you help Rudolph and his friends overcome challenges, enjoy joyful exploration, and experience cooperative gameplay in a festive adventure for the whole family. The Holiday Play Edition includes the King Moonracer’s Kingdom of Misfits DLC Expansion: Help King Moonracer find his toy soldiers who are scattered across the all-new King Moonracer’s Castle region. Venture through 6 secret doors, complete challenges, and search for 24 new bells. Featuring Sam the Snowman as a new playable character. DLC Includes: • All new region featuring six levels, a new storyline, and challenges. • Added playable character: Sam the Snowman. • New game mechanic "Sliding Ice" for exciting platforming challenges. Key Game Features: A BELOVED HOLIDAY CLASSIC – NOW INTERACTIVE: Immerse yourself in the timeless magic of Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer like never before. MAGICAL WINTER WONDERLANDS: Journey through Christmastown, Island of Misfit Toys, Mountain Caves, Santa’s Castle, and more, each filled with holiday cheer and heartwarming adventures. PLAY AS ICONIC CHARACTERS: Step into the hooves of Rudolph and Clarice and the boots of Hermey and Yukon Cornelius, each with unique charm and abilities. JOYFUL CO-OP FUN: Grab a friend and play together in local co-op. FAMILY-FRIENDLY & FULL OF HOLIDAY SPIRIT: Fun challenges, interactive storytelling, and iconic Christmas music make this perfect for festive players of all ages. Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionSwarm Me is a top-down survival game where players defeat massive enemy swarms by luring them into traps, hazards, and environmental kills, relying on movement, items, and positioning. Swarm Me was inspired by the late-round experience of Kino der Toten from Call of Duty: Black Ops, where enemy health scales beyond conventional killing and survival depends entirely on movement, positioning, and environmental traps. The project set out to capture that specific feeling of controlled panic found in high zombie rounds, when weapons become ineffective and only smart use of traps, crowd manipulation, and limited high-impact tools can keep the player alive. Instead of recreating a shooter, Swarm Me distills that late-game tension into a standalone system where direct damage is optional. Enemies are meant to overwhelm, not be cleared efficiently, pushing the player to think and move spatially and tactically. Over time, the design expanded to include multiple modes, usable items, bosses, and optional weapons, while keeping the core philosophy intact: survival through control, not firepower.Show morePublished byEpiXR GamesDeveloped byEpiXR GamesRelease date10/16/2026Play withXBOX Series X|SCapabilities4K Ultra HDSingle player60 fps+120 fpsOptimized for Xbox Series X|SXbox achievementsXbox cloud saves XBOX consoles XBOX games XBOX Game Pass XBOX accessories XBOX News XBOX Support Feedback Community Standards Photosensitive Seizure Warning User Research at XBOX Microsoft account Microsoft Store Support Returns Orders tracking Store locations Rewards Games Designed for XBOX English (United States) Your Privacy Choices Opt-Out Icon Your Privacy Choices Consumer Health Privacy Sitemap Contact Microsoft Privacy & Cookies Manage cookies Terms of use Trademarks Third Party Notices Safety & eco About our ads
